## Metodo X-11

```{r}
library(fpp3)
install.packages("seasonal")
```

```{r}
library(seasonal)
x11_dcmp <- us_retail_employment |>
  model(x11 = X_13ARIMA_SEATS(Employed ~ x11())) |>
  components()
autoplot(x11_dcmp) +
  labs(
    x = "Mes",
    title = "Descomposición X-11 del empleo total en el comercio minorista de EE.UU."
  )
```

```{r}
x11_dcmp <- us_retail_employment |>
  model(
    classical_decomposition(Employed, type = "additive")
  ) |>
  components()
autoplot(x11_dcmp) +
  labs(
    x = "Mes",
    title = "Descomposición aditiva del empleo total en el comercio minorista de EE.UU."
  )
```

```{r}
us_retail_employment |>
  model(
    STL(
      Employed ~ trend(window = 11) +
        season(window = "periodic"),
      robust = FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot() +
  labs(x = "Mes")
```
